# Operations Requirements Quality Checklist: Back-office Operations

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of spec 021 in six areas: privacy boundary, audit completeness, authorization and second factor, plan-edit safety, accessibility and RTL, design fidelity.
**Created**: 2026-10-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Review (2026-10-05, owner away, delegated authority)**: every item was evaluated against spec.md, plan.md and contracts/. Items that failed were fixed in the spec in the same pass (noted "fixed"); evidence follows each item.

## Privacy boundary

- [x] CHK001 Is every category of data the account page must never show enumerated, rather than described generally? [Completeness, Spec §FR-022] — display name, wallet/category names, amounts, balances, notes, transactions, budget figures, device names, stored address.
- [x] CHK002 Is it specified whether the forbidden data must be absent from component state and markup, not only from visible text? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022, SC-003] — "its markup and its component state".
- [x] CHK003 Is the rule for showing an address on the account page unambiguous for both ways of reaching it? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022] — typed (normalised) address only when found by address; none when by id.
- [x] CHK004 Is the conflict between showing wallet counts and the public promise "nobody outside it sees … that it exists" resolved in requirements? [Conflict, Spec §FR-063, Assumptions] — fixed: FR-063 requires the privacy-commitments promise (en/ar) and mapping row.
- [x] CHK005 Are the overview's aggregate rules quantified (which figures, floor value, treatment of 0)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-010, FR-011] — floor 10; 0 exact.
- [x] CHK006 Is the presentation of manual grants consistent with ADR-0013 "manual is never a payment"? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010] — fixed: *Granted · Manual*, never counted as paid.
- [x] CHK007 Are money figures explicitly excluded from the overview? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK008 Is the claim queue's handling of addresses specified for both the list and the search? [Coverage, Spec §FR-015] — rows carry no address; exact address search allowed, budgeted, not recorded.
- [x] CHK009 Is enumeration resistance specified for every path to an account, including direct URLs and links? [Coverage, Spec §FR-061] — fixed: budget spent by every account-page opening however reached.
- [x] CHK010 Are application-log contents bounded for back-office requests? [Completeness, Spec §FR-062]

## Audit completeness

- [x] CHK011 Does every state-changing act map to exactly one named event, writer, actor and subject? [Completeness, contracts/audit.md, Spec §FR-019, FR-030, FR-038]
- [x] CHK012 Is it specified which reads are recorded and which are not, with a reason for each exclusion? [Clarity, contracts/audit.md, Spec §FR-013, FR-053, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK013 Is "one entry per opening" defined precisely enough to distinguish a page open from a re-render or a post-action refresh? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017, FR-024; research R-3]
- [x] CHK014 Is the `audit_read` subject and detail shape specified for unfiltered reads? [Completeness, Spec §FR-044; data-model]
- [x] CHK015 Are audit-entry contents constrained so no price, capability value or address enters an entry? [Consistency with baseline, Spec §FR-038, contracts/audit.md]
- [x] CHK016 Is atomicity between an act and its entry required (plan change, audit read)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-038; research R-5, R-8]
- [x] CHK017 Are the new vocabulary items (actions, subject type) required to change in the baseline and database in the same change? [Traceability, Spec §FR-040, FR-063]
- [x] CHK018 Is the risk of free-text reasons carrying personal data addressed? [Gap, Spec §FR-030a] — fixed: reason-field hint required.

## Authorization and second factor

- [x] CHK019 Is the set of actions requiring a fresh second factor listed exhaustively? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK020 Is per-request authorization (not page-load only) required for every component? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK021 Are the outcomes of a cancelled or wrong factor specified? [Coverage, Spec US1·6, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK022 Are session-expiry-mid-dialog outcomes specified? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK023 Are channel and account-state rules for grant/extend/revoke enforced at the command level, not only on screen? [Consistency, Spec §FR-029]
- [x] CHK024 Is grant eligibility for unverified accounts stated? [Gap, Spec §Clarifications] — fixed: active accounts, verified or not.

## Plan-edit safety

- [x] CHK025 Are editable and non-editable plan fields enumerated, including the plan code's invisibility? [Completeness, Spec §FR-031–FR-034]
- [x] CHK026 Are validation bounds quantified for every editable field? [Measurability, Spec §FR-032; data-model]
- [x] CHK027 Is P-09 rule 5 (default plan) expressed as a testable rule for every caller? [Clarity, Spec §FR-033]
- [x] CHK028 Is concurrent editing resolved (lost-update prevention and its message)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-035, US4·6]
- [x] CHK029 Is the effect of price changes on submitted claims and existing subscriptions specified? [Coverage, Spec §FR-036, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK030 Is the interaction between back-office edits and deployment seeding specified? [Gap closed, Spec §FR-039]
- [x] CHK031 Is lowering a quota below current usage addressed? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]

## Accessibility and RTL

- [x] CHK032 Are keyboard, focus-trap, colour-independence and error-association requirements stated for every screen? [Completeness, Spec §FR-056]
- [x] CHK033 Are RTL rules specified for mixed-direction content (ids, references, addresses, amounts)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-054, FR-055, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK034 Are phone-width requirements quantified? [Measurability, Spec Edge Cases, SC-006] — 390 px, no page-level horizontal scroll.
- [x] CHK035 Are stable test hooks required for acceptance automation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-057; contracts/routes-and-screens.md]

## Design fidelity

- [x] CHK036 Is the design source identified by artifact and version, with the boards used? [Traceability, Spec Assumptions; research R-15]
- [x] CHK037 Is every board element the spec overrides listed as a recorded gap rather than left implicit? [Completeness, research R-15]
- [x] CHK038 Are screens without a board identified, with the rule for composing them? [Coverage, research R-15]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Six items needed spec changes (CHK004, CHK006, CHK009, CHK018, CHK024; CHK030 was already covered): FR-010, FR-061, FR-030a, FR-063, the grant clarification, and a notification-link edge case were added or tightened.
- The visual fidelity record itself (`checklists/fidelity.md`) is written at implementation, against the built screens.
